title: Ask HN: Could DNA be represented as "an embedding" in an AI model?
excerpt: Where each Array element is a numerical value that corresponds to the order of TCAG chemicals on the crossbar of the helix of a DNA strand?
content_html:
Where each Array element is a numerical value that corresponds to the order of TCAG chemicals on the crossbar of the helix of a DNA strand?

Has anyone modeled many DNA strands in this way?

If it was done, what kinds of problems could we solve using AI - assuming we could model any known DNA, and predict out generations?

-----

I guess there are at least a couple options:

1) Model an entire DNA strand as 1 model, with each gene (section of DNA) being a vector. So you'd have, say, a C. elegans model. You could play with that species in an AI sandbox.

2) Model all of DNA (the way we model all of language) to end up with a "DNA AI" that can produce any kind of strand (perhaps inventing genes that don't exist, but could). So here you have a biology sandbox, where you can invent perhaps new creatures, or predict out future states of humans, to test drugs and other things (I guess?)

What do you think, what's possible?

其中每个数组元素都是一个数值，对应于 DNA 链螺旋横杆上 TCAG 化学物质的顺序？

有人用这种方法模拟过许多 DNA 链吗？

如果做到了，我们可以使用人工智能解决什么样的问题——假设我们可以对任何已知的 DNA 进行建模，并预测世代？

-----

我想至少有几个选择：

1) 将整个 DNA 链建模为 1 个模型，其中每个基因（DNA 部分）都是一个向量。 所以你会得到一个 C。 线虫模型。 你可以在人工智能沙盒中与该物种一起玩。

2）对所有 DNA 进行建模（我们对所有语言进行建模的方式），最终得到一个可以产生任何类型链的“DNA AI”（也许发明了不存在但可以存在的基因）。 所以这里有一个生物学沙箱，你可以在其中发明新的生物，或者预测人类的未来状态，以测试药物和其他东西（我猜？）

你觉得怎么样，有什么可能？
